lead_raw_text:
The structure of Cs8Mg4Tb4Cl24 (reduced formula Cs2MgTbCl6) crystallizes in the cubic space group Fm-3m (No. 216), with 40 atoms in the unit cell distributed over four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies octahedral Mg and Tb centers, each coordinated by six Cl neighbors, alongside 12-coordinate Cs in a close-packed-like local arrangement; Cl centers show two geometric neighbors, one Mg and one Tb. Polyhedron-sharing relations include corner-sharing between Mg and Tb octahedra, and face-sharing between Cs and both Mg and Tb polyhedra. The neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 40 sites.
